text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends that minor street stop signs be installed at three uncontrolled three-way intersections. The stops signs will clearly define the right-of-way, regulate traffic flow, encourage motorists to stop before the sidewalk to enhance pedestrian safety and provide uniformity in the area.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Lapworth Crescent (south intersection) at Morbank Drive. 2. Authorized compulsory stop control for eastbound traffic on Lapworth Crescent (north intersection) at Morbank Drive. 3. Designated Morbank Drive, from Ivy Bush Avenue to a point 150 metres north, as a through highway.
